evidence.title: Claude Code (update: claude plugin update kami)

name: Kami
summary: Agent skill that lays out briefs as PDF, PNG and PowerPoint documents — resumes, slides, reports — with a parchment design system.
description: Kami installs into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents as a skill that turns requests like "make a one-pager" or "build me a resume" into laid-out documents: eight templates (One-Pager, Long Doc, Letter, Portfolio, Resume, Slides, Equity Report, Changelog) plus a landing-page system, in English, Chinese and Korean variants. It renders HTML to PDF with WeasyPrint, editable PPTX with python-pptx and Marp decks, draws 18 inline SVG diagram types from data or Mermaid, and ships a zero-dependency MCP server.
contains: 8 document templates: One-Pager, Long Doc, Letter, Portfolio, Resume, Slides, Equity Report, Changelog
landing page system; English, Chinese and Korean template variants
renders PDF via WeasyPrint, editable PPTX via python-pptx, Markdown decks via Marp
18 inline SVG diagram types; sequence, class and ER from Mermaid text
zero-dependency MCP server with render, check and screenshot tools
structure and coverage checks plus a structured brief before delivery
parchment default (#f5f4ed) with ink-blue accents; white-paper print variant
MIT licensed; installs as a skill into Claude Code, Codex and Cursor
